Implement only the requested OGX feature. Read AGENTS.md, Copilot instructions, and the security model first. Keep target repositories read-only; do not execute project code, install dependencies into targets, or write config/reports there. Store state externally. Add tests, update docs and changelog, run compileall and all tests, and state any validation that could not be completed. Do not claim unsupported capabilities.
